questions.prompt: Read the text and decide if each sentence is true or false.
questions.explanation: The text says 'save time and money', 'managers often worry' and 'feeling isolated'.
questions.passage: Remote working has changed the way many companies operate. Employees say they save time and money because they do not need to travel. However, managers often worry that staff are less productive at home, and some workers report feeling isolated from their colleagues.

statements.text: Employees say remote working saves them time.
All managers believe staff work better at home.
